description: Fetch one research article by its URL slug — the last path segment of a /research/<slug> URL. Use this after search_research_articles to read a specific study, or when the user names an article or pastes one of its URLs. format 'summary' (the default) returns headline, description, date and read time; format 'full' also returns the complete article body as markdown, which is what you want if the user asks about the methodology, the numbers, or what the study actually found.

client.description: Optional: identify yourself, e.g. "my-agent/1.0". Not required and never used by the tool itself — recorded only so the public tracker at /projects/agent-tools can measure how many callers self-identify when nothing forces them to.

name: get_article
